about:
# Social Diary

A World of Warcraft addon that remembers the people you meet in the open world.

You group with a stranger for an hour in the Barrens, trade a few potions with
someone in Redridge, get killed twice by the same rogue in Hillsbrad. A week
later you meet one of them again and can't place the name. Social Diary writes
these meetings down for you: who you grouped with, traded with, whispered,
fought beside or against, who killed you, who you saw along the road, and when
you met again.

It keeps your own journey too: levels, firsts, the zones you
passed through, close calls, lucky drops, the end of long quest chains and
profession caps. All of it is written into a paper journal automatically.

Made for **WoW Forever** (currently in beta): classic-era content on the
retail addon API. Current version: 1.5.0.

## Install

Install the Addon like you do with any oter WoW Addon: Put it in your game's `Interface/AddOns` folder.

Download a release rather than the repository itself.

## Getting started

Opening it the first time, an Onboarding Message will appear. After that, you can type `/sd` to open the journal.

Ideally, bind a key in the Settings to open the journal quickly.

### How the Diary works

People you only cross paths with are _pencilled in_ by themselves. If they
never turn out to matter, they are rubbed out after 30 days (you can change
this in _Settings_). Anyone you add is _inked in_ and stays for good.

_Settings_ → _Interface_ → _Keybinds & Shortcuts_ has keys for the journal and
for _Remember this_, and macros you can drag onto an action bar.

## Questie (optional)

Social Diary works on its own. If [Questie](https://github.com/Questie) and
QuestieDB are installed, the diary reads their data as well:

- creatures are written down by their real names;
- quest drops are measured against their real drop rates, so a lucky or
  unlucky one gets its own card;
- _Settings_ gains an _Integrations_ page that shows whether Questie was found.

## Privacy

All data stays on your computer.

## Contributing

Bug reports and ideas are welcome in
[Issues](https://github.com/social-diary/social_diary/issues). Questions go to
[Discussions](https://github.com/social-diary/social_diary/discussions). If you
would like to change the code, start with [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/social-diary/social_diary/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Credits

- **Neuton Italic** font: Copyright 2010 The Neuton Project Authors, licensed
  under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. It ships unmodified in `Fonts/`, with
  the licence in `Fonts/OFL.txt`.
- **Goodmountain** font by Hermann S Designs
  ([github.com/Hermann-S-Designs/Goodmountain](https://github.com/Hermann-S-Designs/Goodmountain)):
  all rights retained by Hermann S Designs, shared under their end-user
  licence. It ships unmodified and unrenamed in `Fonts/`, with the licence in
  `Fonts/Goodmountain-LICENSE.txt`.
- **Questie and QuestieDB** ([github.com/Questie](https://github.com/Questie)):
  the optional integration reads their data while the game runs.
- **Dungeon Crawler Forever** by Per
  ([github.com/perweum/dungeon-crawler-forever](https://github.com/perweum/dungeon-crawler-forever),
  GPL-3.0-or-later): the dungeon maps, floors, bosses and where they stand,
  wings and routes in `Vendor/DungeonCrawlerForever/` come from it, copied
  with one changed line per file. Its drawn maps credit their artists (the
  WoW Forever dungeons: Santiago Reyes, Atlas de Azeroth: Forever).
- **Map overlay layout** in `UI/Map/OverlayData.lua` is generated by
  `Dev/map_overlays.py` from the game client's DB2 tables, read via
  [wago.tools](https://wago.tools/).
- Releases are packaged with the
  [BigWigs packager](https://github.com/BigWigsMods/packager).

World of Warcraft and Blizzard are trademarks of Blizzard Entertainment. Social

Diary is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by
Blizzard.

## Licence

Social Diary is released under the
[GNU General Public License v3.0 or later](https://github.com/social-diary/social_diary/blob/main/LICENSE), since it includes code
and data from Dungeon Crawler Forever. Releases up to 1.7.0 were under the
MIT License and stay so. The Neuton font is under the
[SIL Open Font License 1.1](https://github.com/social-diary/social_diary/blob/main/Fonts/OFL.txt). The Goodmountain font is not
covered by the GPL: it stays under its
[own licence](https://github.com/social-diary/social_diary/blob/main/Fonts/Goodmountain-LICENSE.txt), which allows sharing it
unmodified with that licence but not changing, renaming or selling it.

# Changelog

## [Unreleased]

## [4.2.6]

This Update makes your save files around 60 to 80% smaller, and a new _Memory_ setting caps how many strangers the diary keeps.

### Shiny new Things

- _Memory_ settings can now cap how many strangers are kept

### Changes

- Strangers now take far less room in your save files

## [4.2.5]

This Update brings five more dungeons to the _Dungeon View_. A quest item everyone in your group loots, like a boss's head, no longer counts as a lucky drop in _Your Diary_.

### Changes

- _Dungeon View_ now knows five more dungeons and more default routes
  - Blackmaw Hold and The Shaper's Terrace maps are in beta

### Fixes

- _Your Diary_ no longer calls quest items the whole group loots lucky

## [4.2.4]

This update brings support for Traditional Chinese.

### Shiny new Things

- Added Traditional Chinese support

## [4.2.3]

A small Update: new gear and more of the diary's wording now read in your language.

### Fixes

- Missing translations added to all languages (thanks CarnVanBeck)

## [4.2.2]

This small update brings improvements to the PvP labels in _Your Diary_.

### Changes

- PvP labels in _Your Diary_ now show the opponents level, class and race, or, if they are in your Diary, their name.
- Improved the design of the PvP labels in _Your Diary_.

### Fixes

- Quest drops are now only judged on looted items. Items that come from trading and mails are ignored for lucky / unlucky cards.

## [4.2.1]

A small Update: people who ride a zeppelin or boat with you, or walk beside you into a new zone, no longer count as seen twice.

### Fixes

- Crossing a zone border no longer counts nearby people as seen twice (thanks OscillatorZ)

## [4.2.0]

This Update brings the diary in Brazilian Portuguese.

### Shiny new Things

- Added Brazilian Portuguese to the diary’s language settings (thanks thiagocoutinhor)

## [4.1.1]

A small Update: the preset tags now speak your language, and Feign Death or healing yourself no longer leaves false deaths and _Close Calls_ in your diary.

### Changes

- The preset tags now show in your language (thanks YaN9Yu96)

### Fixes

- Feign Death no longer counts as a death (thanks JasonLudeli)
- Healing yourself no longer records false _Close Calls_

## [4.1.0]

This Update brings an exciting new Addition to _Your Diary_: Gear Upgrades! Whenever you equip a better Item, it gets written down. Just trying it on will not trigger it. There may be some funkiness going on with 2H->2x1H weapons and so on – Please report issues on this! The Diary also now, optionally, adds Players you encounter often enough automatically.

### Shiny new Things

- _Your Diary_ now detects when you equip upgrades of your existing equipment and displays them on your Diary's plates
- Added Polish to the diary’s language settings (thanks KO.Media)
- You can now make the Diary auto-add players you encounter often or do dungeons and raids with (thanks ubrider, replayablecontent46369)

## [4.0.2]

A hotfix for the Gamepad UI, where opening a player's menu locked the controller. For now, add players with the Remember key or the macros when playing with a controller.

### Fixes

- A player's menu no longer locks the controller with the Gamepad UI
  - The diary's entry is left out of that menu for now
- German zone names now take their article and case (thanks CarnVanBeck)

## [4.0.1]

This update brings support for simplified Chinese as well with some more bug fixes.

### Shiny New Things

- Added Simplified Chinese support (thanks jasonzxy0825)

### Changes

- It's now more likely to _get lucky_ on a quest item hunt, now requiring just half of expected kills instead of an eighth

### Fixes

- In Korean and Chinese Clients, Box / Tofu Characters no longer appear in place of no-break spaces
- Language Fixes for ruRU

## [4.0.0]

This big update brings battleground Views, starting with Warsong Gulch, and the diary in German, Spanish, French and Russian. Both are still early, so please send feedback and translation suggestions on GitHub!

### Shiny new Things

- _Your Diary_ now keeps your battleground matches, with an evening's overview
  - _Toasts_ and timelines tell of diary people you meet there
  - New _Battlegrounds_ settings choose how many full scoreboards are saved
- The diary is now translated into German, Spanish, French and Russian (thanks CarnVanBeck)
  - A new _Language_ page in _Settings_ picks the diary's language
- Suggest a better wording for any line in a translated diary
  - A note greets you the first time the diary speaks your language
- A new UI scale option in _Interface_ settings

### Fixes

- Using the diary with a controller no longer breaks buffs and targeting

## [3.0.2]

This Updates brings small but important UX fixes. Especially the red ink spills that mark your combat zones in _Your Diary_ are now more clearly computed and displayed.

### Changes

- _Dungeon View_ now places deaths, wipes and rolls precisely by mob pack data in Wailing Caverns and Shadowfang Keep

### Changes

- Tooltips in _Your Diary_ Plates now summarize their data instead of showing e.g. 4 times "Fought here for x Minutes"

### Fixes

- Dungeons, battlegrounds and boss fights no longer cause repeated Lua errors
- In _Your Diary_, The red ink spills that mark your combat zones are now more clearly visible.

## [3.0.1]

A Hotfix for Behaviour in Battlegrounds. Currently, BG data is interpreted badly and potentially clogging up a Diary entry. Until a proper Battleground Feature is implemented, BG Capture will be turned off.

### Fixes

- Battleground Activities are currently skipped, because they result in bad Diary data.

## [3.0.0]

A big Update: the diary now works with a controller through WoW's Gamepad UI, and a new _Changelog_ under _About_ in _Settings_ shows what's new after each update.

### Shiny new Things

- The Addon now supports Gamepad UI!
  - You can use almost all diary features just with a controller.
  - Some actions still require Keyboard and Mouse, such as:
    - Editing A Dungeon Route
    - Precise Placing of Custom Events
  - As this is a new feature and Blizzard's Gamepad UI will likely change frequently, bug reports are especially welcome.
- An in-game _Changelog_ in _Settings_, under _About_
  - A hint points you to the _Changelog_ after a big update

### Changes

- _Feedback_ and _Credits_ now sit under _About_ in _Settings_

## [2.4.0]

Just small fixes connected to _Hunts_, Nearby _Toasts_ and the _Dungeon View_.

### Fixes

- _Hunts_ in _Your Diary_ are no longer confused by crafting
- Nearby _Toasts_ and last-seen places ignore group members who are far away
- Items in the _Dungeon View_ can be shift-clicked and ctrl-clicked
- A rare killed again in one session is named once on the timeline

## [2.3.0]

This Update adds support for non-latin languages and pencilled-in preview pages for strangers in _Your Diary_.

### Shiny new Things

- Strangers in _Your Diary_ open a pencilled-in preview of their page

### Fixes

- Names and places now show on Russian, Korean and Chinese clients

## [2.2.1]

Just one small fix, so the journal can be closed during a fight.

### Fixes

- The journal's close button now works in combat

## [2.2.0]

This Update introduces hints, a _Feedback_ page and tamed pets for Hunters, and the _Dungeon View_ now knows which pack killed you.

### Shiny new Things

- Occasional hints point out features you may have missed
- A _Feedback_ page in _Settings_ for bug reports and comments
- Hunters: _Your Diary_ remembers the pets you tame and name

### Changes

- A few rarely used chat commands are gone
  - The sightings switch now lives in _Settings_
- _Dungeon View_ places deaths and wipes at the pack that killed you
  - In Ragefire, the Deadmines, the Stockade and both Razorfens so far
- _Dungeon View_ keeps a wipe's marks and its note together in one spot
- _Dungeon View_ marks no longer drift ahead after idle time

### Fixes

- PvP labels in _Your Diary_ now show the opponents level, class and race, or, if they are in your Diary, their name.
- Improved the design of the PvP labels in _Your Diary_.

### Fixes

- Quest drops are now only judged on looted items. Items that come from trading and mails are ignored for lucky / unlucky cards.

## [4.2.1]

A small Update: people who ride a zeppelin or boat with you, or walk beside you into a new zone, no longer count as seen twice.

### Fixes

- Crossing a zone border no longer counts nearby people as seen twice (thanks OscillatorZ)

## [4.2.0]

This Update brings the diary in Brazilian Portuguese.

### Shiny new Things

- Added Brazilian Portuguese to the diary’s language settings (thanks thiagocoutinhor)

## [4.1.1]

A small Update: the preset tags now speak your language, and Feign Death or healing yourself no longer leaves false deaths and _Close Calls_ in your diary.

### Changes

- The preset tags now show in your language (thanks YaN9Yu96)

### Fixes

- Feign Death no longer counts as a death (thanks JasonLudeli)
- Healing yourself no longer records false _Close Calls_

## [4.1.0]

This Update brings an exciting new Addition to _Your Diary_: Gear Upgrades! Whenever you equip a better Item, it gets written down. Just trying it on will not trigger it. There may be some funkiness going on with 2H->2x1H weapons and so on – Please report issues on this! The Diary also now, optionally, adds Players you encounter often enough automatically.

### Shiny new Things

- _Your Diary_ now detects when you equip upgrades of your existing equipment and displays them on your Diary's plates
- Added Polish to the diary’s language settings (thanks KO.Media)
- You can now make the Diary auto-add players you encounter often or do dungeons and raids with (thanks ubrider, replayablecontent46369)

## [4.0.2]

A hotfix for the Gamepad UI, where opening a player's menu locked the controller. For now, add players with the Remember key or the macros when playing with a controller.

### Fixes

- A player's menu no longer locks the controller with the Gamepad UI
  - The diary's entry is left out of that menu for now
- German zone names now take their article and case (thanks CarnVanBeck)

## [4.0.1]

This update brings support for simplified Chinese as well with some more bug fixes.

### Shiny New Things

- Added Simplified Chinese support (thanks jasonzxy0825)

### Changes

- It's now more likely to _get lucky_ on a quest item hunt, now requiring just half of expected kills instead of an eighth

### Fixes

- In Korean and Chinese Clients, Box / Tofu Characters no longer appear in place of no-break spaces
- Language Fixes for ruRU

## [4.0.0]

This big update brings battleground Views, starting with Warsong Gulch, and the diary in German, Spanish, French and Russian. Both are still early, so please send feedback and translation suggestions on GitHub!

### Shiny new Things

- _Your Diary_ now keeps your battleground matches, with an evening's overview
  - _Toasts_ and timelines tell of diary people you meet there
  - New _Battlegrounds_ settings choose how many full scoreboards are saved
- The diary is now translated into German, Spanish, French and Russian (thanks CarnVanBeck)
  - A new _Language_ page in _Settings_ picks the diary's language
- Suggest a better wording for any line in a translated diary
  - A note greets you the first time the diary speaks your language
- A new UI scale option in _Interface_ settings

### Fixes

- Using the diary with a controller no longer breaks buffs and targeting

## [3.0.2]

This Updates brings small but important UX fixes. Especially the red ink spills that mark your combat zones in _Your Diary_ are now more clearly computed and displayed.

### Changes

- _Dungeon View_ now places deaths, wipes and rolls precisely by mob pack data in Wailing Caverns and Shadowfang Keep

### Changes

- Tooltips in _Your Diary_ Plates now summarize their data instead of showing e.g. 4 times "Fought here for x Minutes"

### Fixes

- Dungeons, battlegrounds and boss fights no longer cause repeated Lua errors
- In _Your Diary_, The red ink spills that mark your combat zones are now more clearly visible.

## [3.0.1]

A Hotfix for Behaviour in Battlegrounds. Currently, BG data is interpreted badly and potentially clogging up a Diary entry. Until a proper Battleground Feature is implemented, BG Capture will be turned off.

### Fixes

- Battleground Activities are currently skipped, because they result in bad Diary data.

## [3.0.0]

A big Update: the diary now works with a controller through WoW's Gamepad UI, and a new _Changelog_ under _About_ in _Settings_ shows what's new after each update.

### Shiny new Things

- The Addon now supports Gamepad UI!
  - You can use almost all diary features just with a controller.
  - Some actions still require Keyboard and Mouse, such as:
    - Editing A Dungeon Route
    - Precise Placing of Custom Events
  - As this is a new feature and Blizzard's Gamepad UI will likely change frequently, bug reports are especially welcome.
- An in-game _Changelog_ in _Settings_, under _About_
  - A hint points you to the _Changelog_ after a big update

### Changes

- _Feedback_ and _Credits_ now sit under _About_ in _Settings_

## [2.4.0]

Just small fixes connected to _Hunts_, Nearby _Toasts_ and the _Dungeon View_.

### Fixes

- _Hunts_ in _Your Diary_ are no longer confused by crafting
- Nearby _Toasts_ and last-seen places ignore group members who are far away
- Items in the _Dungeon View_ can be shift-clicked and ctrl-clicked
- A rare killed again in one session is named once on the timeline

## [2.3.0]

This Update adds support for non-latin languages and pencilled-in preview pages for strangers in _Your Diary_.

### Shiny new Things

- Strangers in _Your Diary_ open a pencilled-in preview of their page

### Fixes

- Names and places now show on Russian, Korean and Chinese clients

## [2.2.1]

Just one small fix, so the journal can be closed during a fight.

### Fixes

- The journal's close button now works in combat

## [2.2.0]

This Update introduces hints, a _Feedback_ page and tamed pets for Hunters, and the _Dungeon View_ now knows which pack killed you.

### Shiny new Things

- Occasional hints point out features you may have missed
- A _Feedback_ page in _Settings_ for bug reports and comments
- Hunters: _Your Diary_ remembers the pets you tame and name

### Changes

- A few rarely used chat commands are gone
  - The sightings switch now lives in _Settings_
- _Dungeon View_ places deaths and wipes at the pack that killed you
  - In Ragefire, the Deadmines, the Stockade and both Razorfens so far
- _Dungeon View_ keeps a wipe's marks and its note together in one spot
- _Dungeon View_ marks no longer drift ahead after idle time

### Fixes

- _Dungeon View_ spreads deaths along the way before the first boss falls

## [2.1.0]

This Update lets you add your own events to _Your Diary_ and makes getting started shorter, along with a good round of fixes.

### Shiny new Things

- _Your Diary_ now allows adding custom events by right clicking the Map
- _Dungeon View_ explains its default route the first time it opens
- Paper texture intensity can be set in _Settings_

### Changes

- Onboarding and the login parcel are shorter and easier to follow
- Any key or mouse button can be bound to the addon's shortcuts
- Clicking your current dungeon in _Your Diary_ opens its _Dungeon View_

### Fixes
